purpose: Design for ordered backend selection (doc-link or doc-db) in the four document-search wrappers, covering availability checks, direct HTTP access to doc-db, on-demand startup, index preparation, delegation and error handling.
summary: Backend order resolved from .claude/.forge.yaml doc_backend.prefer, default doc-link first; invalid settings yield settings_invalid with no fallback
Responsibility split: each backend owns its availability check, the selector SKILL owns the order, and operation failures never switch backends
doc-db access via a stdlib Streamable HTTP client with JSON/SSE parsing, on-demand startup and probe constants
doc-link availability judged by query-docs, index-docs, embed-dlid and uv; version is never used
doc-db query design: project key and series, series-limited search, path existence check, exit codes 0/10/20/30
Missing index handled by user approval then delegation to update-db-* with an explicit backend, then one re-query
doc-db update via desired-state sync with --start and --status polling driven by the SKILL
doc-link update: prepare input, embed DLIDs, build index; freshness checks left to doc-link, never guessed
doc-db MCP tool contract snapshot, KEY_NOT_FOUND and KEY_TRASHED handling by error code
Component diagram, sequence diagrams, error table, notifications and unit/wrapper/integration/contract test design
tasks: Implementing or modifying query-db-rules, query-db-specs, update-db-rules and update-db-specs SKILLs
Changing doc_backend scripts such as query_docdb.py, sync_docdb.py, docdb_client.py, docdb_runtime.py and resolve_backend_order.py
Adding or changing the doc_backend.prefer setting
Designing or reviewing doc-link or doc-db integration and backend switching
Writing or updating tests and lint checks for the wrappers and contract
Handling index-missing, trashed key or sync failure errors
Updating the doc-db MCP contract snapshot
